prompt.project_info: Create a candid post-workout portrait of an approved adult woman resting in a high-end minimalist brutalist wellness space.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with a slicked-back high ponytail and composed, slightly tired expression looking toward a window. She wears a charcoal-grey athletic set with a sports bra and high-waisted leggings, with an oversized cardigan draped off one shoulder. A stainless-steel water bottle rests nearby and she holds a smartphone.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 eye-level medium shot, subject seated on a polished concrete floor against textured raw concrete beside a large Monstera plant. Show the scale of floor-to-ceiling industrial windows and architecture.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural light through large industrial windows creates long defined shadows and subtle dust in the rays. Quiet luxury, raw concrete texture, and realistic post-workout glow.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high detail, 9:16 vertical framing, sharp subject with slightly softer architecture, realistic skin, fabric, metal, plant, and concrete texture.
